interval_rule: Simultaneous finite bounded-mean Chernoff-KL intervals, total alpha.05, cap512 TWO-SIDED INTERVALS, tail budget.05/(2*512). Actual fixed roster338intervals/676bounds. Power/FDP range[0,1]. Only paired PB_grid-minus-PB_main POWER range[0,1] by pointwise evidence domination; other paired differences[-1,1]. Descriptive paired SE also reported, not formal CI. Whole families independent; no gene pseudoreplicates.
precision: Fixed512 per scene: worst-case MCSE2.21pp for[0,1]means and4.42pp for[-1,1]paired differences; simultaneous finite CIs wider. No sample extension for significance. DEV estimates motivated this cost/precision; theory is not certified by empirical FDR CI.
classical_reference_qualification: BB_BY is the valid marginal BB/BY comparator. Historical BB_eBH is EMPIRICAL_ONLY because TRAIN-learned calibration of a marginal BB p lacks conditional validity; retained not promoted. PB_grid_ordinary is also fully justified within M0. Strong/V1 remain practical empirical references, not new theorems.
primary_questions: Does PB_grid retain useful nonzero power under M0 while accounting for finite calibration and learning?
What paired efficiency does discrete calibration recover?
What loss remains versus practical strong and ordinary references?
decision: Classify guarantee and utility separately; no fixed gain target. PROVED_BUT_COSTLY if valid model theorem but material losses persist. No requirement to outrank V1; no claim of high-level novelty from theorem alone.
freeze_rule: Freeze sources, parameters, all15cases and reporting before generating any C001 input. One confirmation only; no reserve confirmation. Exact numerical defect would invalidate affected results, require recorded new plan rather than silent replacement.
stop: Attempt all15x512 independent whole families once. No sequential significance stopping or enlargement. Per-batch safety7200seconds with checkpoint preservation, not a phase deadline. Hard failures invalidate summaries rather than silently dropping families.
boundary_rule: last2cases OUTSIDE M0; Delta1,2,5 fixed sensitivity outputs, not fitted bounds. Historical drift motivated them, so not new proof of transport. Ratio2.2 covered only by5; ratio4.6 covered only by5. No assumed real-data source for these bounds.
